# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
1. The full gate caught the M2 guard refusing the legitimate explicit
   --partial delivery flow. Certifying success and declaring incompleteness
   are different acts; guards must name which one they block. Cost: one
   gate re-run.
2. M12 measured live: the store's claims and the sibling's scope reconcile
   were two one-writer registries that could not see each other; a
   correctly claimed path was named undeclared at every peer stop. Fixed by
   rendering agent-bearing fence lines the INSTALLED parser accepts, pinned
   against the installed file, per the install-boundary lesson.
3. A worktree-isolated builder starts from HEAD, not from the main tree's
   uncommitted state; the A2 fix batch had to restore the uncommitted work
   byte-verified first. Orchestrator merges deltas and re-runs every check
   itself.
4. The A2 codex debate returned NOT READY with 6 blockers in code four
   suites had already passed, including a raw-store egress bypassing the
   export policy (the vault's raw-read class, caught before merge). The
   cross-family debate at part close earns its cost.
5. Registries lag new code: the effects REGISTRY, write_sites inventory,
   py-modules and the SECURITY.md line count each went red in the gate
   after new files landed. Check all four in the same change as any new
   verb or tool.
6. Secret-scan false-positive class: prose like test_a_task_cannot matches
   the sk_ pattern; inspect hits, never auto-clear, never auto-ignore.
7. Two builder worktrees survived their agents; sbe verify's pruned-dirs
   note surfaced them. Remove worktrees at merge time.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
